title: Add NFT collections to Werkverzeichnis with preview images and Getgems links

requirements.summary: Update NFTCollectionsSection.tsx to display all seven NFT collections with exact Getgems URLs and dedicated preview images from generated assets
acceptanceCriteria: All seven collection cards are visible in the NFT collections section
Each card shows the correct collection name and a unique preview image
Clicking a card opens the exact Getgems URL for that collection in a new browser tab
No collection is missing or has a wrong URL
Preview images are loaded from frontend/public/assets/generated

file_operations.description: Update the collections array to include all seven NFT collections with their exact Getgems URLs: Lichtei (https://getgems.io/lichtei), Wheel of Time (https://getgems.io/wheeloftime), Colour Shades (https://getgems.io/colourshades), Schieferlichtgrafik (https://getgems.io/collection/EQCgrHXOmAryUksLLtlh5dsXyT_h2DF6vLiEUiwsj05KFjJM), Light Seekers (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA1W-YI6IGmi_94KoIgwgD79i_bhz0Uot-Z1y5W8fBGuIAz), Panel Paintings (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA_bfpwKniQOAATWojdfIDk9X7_mCW_Stpzt_1kDSF6UDYV), and Flammenbilder Fire Dance (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA8b4VisUmrk2tiumRI-wmlM3QhahoGeGNqSYzrO6s9O2Vf). Each collection must reference its corresponding preview image from frontend/public/assets/generated using the exact workspace paths: frontend/public/assets/generated/lichtei-preview.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/wheeloftime-preview.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/colourshades-preview.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/schieferlichtgrafik-preview.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/light-seekers-preview.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/panel-paintings-preview.dim_800x600.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/fire-dance-preview.dim_800x600.png. Each collection card must link directly to its Getgems URL with target='_blank' to open in a new tab. Do not change the NFTCollectionCard component's interface or behavior beyond providing the correct image paths and URLs.
